Observation: Tricolor Holdings filed Chapter 7 bankruptcy with ~$2B debt and 25,000+ creditors. Specialized in subprime auto loans to low/no-credit buyers without credit checks.
PrimaLend Capital Partners filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy. Listed $286M debt. CEO stated "not going out of business" but seeking restructuring.
DOJ charged Tricolor executives: Daniel Chu (CEO), Daniel Goodgame (COO), Jerome Kollar, Ameryn Seibold. Allegations: double-pledging, data manipulation, fabricated payments. Scheme ran 2018-2025.
JPMorgan Chase disclosed $170M loss from Tricolor exposure. Fifth Third Bank disclosed $200M loss and cooperating with law enforcement.
Jerome Kollar and Ameryn Seibold pled guilty to fraud charges and are cooperating with government investigation. May lead to additional charges/discoveries.
First Brands bankruptcy revealed double-pledging in supply chain and inventory finance. CEO Patrick James blames "predatory" creditors. Trial scheduled June 2026.
Warehouse lenders reassessing all subprime auto exposure. Tighter covenants, increased scrutiny expected. Recommendations for shared collateral registries emerging.
Fed SLOOS shows banks tightening credit standards for subprime auto. Delinquencies and repossessions climbing toward 2009 levels. Credit access declining.
